name: Sela Hallow
source_profile: ● Sela Hallow (NG) is Edrik's daughter and a respected healer who maintains close relationships with Hollowbough and Velthari herbalists. She advocates cooperation with neighboring peoples against threats to the forests.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 57 (source excerpt; may be partial)
